comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Code review summary for MVP completeness review:

Assessment: With gaps.

Critical gaps:
- Character creation exists in core but is not reachable from CLI campaign flow.
- CLI graceful close writes a stub recap instead of a real campaign-memory summary.
- Checkpoint restore/fork/list exist in core but have no user-facing CLI workflow.

Important gaps:
- Profile override docs are ahead of runtime wiring.
- Structured turn traces store placeholder fields for real turns.
- First-turn scene persistence depends on the model choosing mark_scene.

Minor gaps:
- ADR 0002 says Stage 1 CLI includes streaming, but current model/CLI path is whole-response output.
- AGENTS.md test-count expectation is stale.

Acceptable post-MVP deferrals noted by reviewer: packaging/release/default user data locations, character import, structured panels/VTT/native mobile/hosted credits, third-party adventure conversion.

Follow-up beads created:
- loreweaver-xeu, loreweaver-32m, loreweaver-v3k, loreweaver-ksk, loreweaver-abt, loreweaver-buu, loreweaver-jqk, loreweaver-vmp.

Scope/verification: reviewer inspected README, architecture report, ADRs 0001/0002, character/world/game-state docs, CLI/core source and tests. Reviewer ran npm run test: 35 test files passed, 195 tests passed, 1 skipped. Worktree remained clean.
